evidence.quote: the Committee decided to maintain the target range for the federal funds rate at 1 to 1-1/4 percent
The Committee expects that economic conditions will evolve in a manner that will warrant gradual increases in the federal funds rate
On a 12-month basis, overall inflation and the measure excluding food and energy prices have declined and are running below 2 percent.
The Committee expects to begin implementing its balance sheet normalization program relatively soon, provided that the economy evolves broadly as anticipated
the labor market has continued to strengthen and that economic activity has been rising moderately so far this year
Near-term risks to the economic outlook appear roughly balanced, but the Committee is monitoring inflation developments closely.

parsed.rationale: The Committee held rates steady while signaling gradual increases ahead and an imminent start to balance sheet runoff, against a strengthening labor market. This is a mild hawkish lean, tempered by inflation running below 2 percent and close monitoring of inflation.
